title: NLP Basics: Understanding Bag of Words and Its Applications in Machine Learning

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome back to the Machine Learning A to Z course.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎回到 Machine Learning A-Z。

cues.en: Super excited to have you back here on board for this new part on natural language processing.
cues.zh: 很高興你回來，參與自然語言處理這個新部分。

cues.en: In this quick tutorial, we'll go over what is coming up for us in terms of the intuition of videos to better understand natural language processing.
cues.zh: 這堂快速看接下來的概念影片，幫助理解自然語言處理。

cues.en: So first thing that I wanted to mention is that the upcoming videos that you will see are actually taken from a specialized course that we have in the space of natural language processing,
cues.zh: 首先要提，接下來影片其實取自我們專門的自然語言處理課，

cues.en: it's called Deep Learning and NLP A to Z.
cues.zh: 叫 Deep Learning and NLP A-Z。

cues.en: And why I'm saying that is you will hear references to things like deep learning or SEC-to-SEC models and other things.
cues.zh: 之所以先說，是因為會聽到深度學習、Seq2Seq 模型等內容。

cues.en: So I wanted to clarify what is important to us in this specific part of the course and what needs to be disregarded.
cues.zh: 所以想釐清這部分的重要內容，以及哪些先不必理會。

cues.en: So let's have a look.
cues.zh: 來看看。

cues.en: In this section, here is what we'll be focusing on.
cues.zh: 本單元重點如下。

cues.en: So we will have a tutorial on types of natural language processing.
cues.zh: 有一堂介紹自然語言處理的類型。

cues.en: So we'll discuss all different sorts of types and I think that's a great way to become aware of what exists in the world of natural language processing, even if it includes the deep learning models
cues.zh: 討論各種類型，是了解 NLP 領域有哪些技術的好方法，即使包括深度學習模型，

cues.en: or even the more advanced SEC-to-SEC models.
cues.zh: 甚至更進階的 Seq2Seq 模型。

cues.en: So you'll hear those terms.
cues.zh: 會聽到這些詞。

cues.en: But our focus here will be on a different type of natural language processing model which will come up just now.
cues.zh: 但這裡著重的是另一種 NLP 模型，馬上就介紹。

cues.en: Then you'll actually have a, we'll have a tutorial on classical versus deep learning models and we'll discuss the differences between them and different kind of use case
cues.zh: 接著一堂比較傳統與深度學習模型，討論差異、不同使用情境，

cues.en: and some examples as well, again, to increase our awareness of the space of natural language processing.
cues.zh: 也會舉例，同樣為了拓展對自然語言處理領域的認識。

cues.en: And finally, we'll have a tutorial specifically dedicated to the bag of words model.
cues.zh: 最後有一堂專談詞袋模型。

cues.en: So that is the main tutorial that we need to be focusing on because that's the model that you will be building together with Alan in the practical tutorials.
cues.zh: 這是主要重點，因為實作課會和 Hadelin 一起建立這個模型。

cues.en: And we'll get the intuition behind bag of words in this tutorial.
cues.zh: 這堂會理解詞袋背後直覺。

cues.en: And just so that we're on the same page, in this part or in this course on Machine Learning A to Z, we're not going to be talking about the SEC-to-SEC model
cues.zh: 也先說清楚，Machine Learning A-Z 這部分或整門課，不會談 Seq2Seq 模型，

cues.en: or chatbots or deep natural language processing.
cues.zh: 聊天機器人，或深度自然語言處理。

cues.en: Those are more advanced topics.
cues.zh: 那些比較進階。

cues.en: If you'd like to discover them and take your natural language processing skills further after this section, of course, you can always have a look and we invite you to have a look at our
cues.zh: 這單元後若想探索、進一步提升 NLP 技能，當然歡迎看看

cues.en: course that was mentioned just before, Deep Learning and Natural Language Processing A to Z.
cues.zh: 剛提到的 Deep Learning and Natural Language Processing A-Z。

cues.en: And you can find a lot of those things there.
cues.zh: 裡面有很多相關內容。

cues.en: But even this awareness of natural language processing and this bag of words model and the practical applications that you'll be discussing with Alan is going to be a great start into the world
cues.zh: 但即使只是認識 NLP、詞袋模型，以及和 Hadelin 討論的實際應用，也會是進入

cues.en: of NLP and will allow you to practice certain skills of pulling text apart and getting insights from text.
cues.zh: NLP 世界的好起點，讓你練習拆解文字、從文字取得洞見。

cues.en: Very exciting tutorials coming up.
cues.zh: 接下來課程很精彩。

cues.en: Can't wait for you to get started with this part of the course.
cues.zh: 期待你開始這部分。

cues.en: So without further ado, let's dive straight into it.
cues.zh: 不再多說，直接進入。

cues.en: And until next time, happy analyzing.
cues.zh: 下次見，在那之前，祝你分析愉快。
